adaptation_notes: The stb port installs the stb headers and a FindStb module but no imported target: the build fragment calls find_package(Stb REQUIRED) and defines stb::truetype from Stb_INCLUDE_DIR.
The allocation binding's glue compiles stb_truetype's implementation, so no other translation unit defines STB_TRUETYPE_IMPLEMENTATION; game code includes <stb_truetype.h> for the declarations.
